_format.note: Run-long passive items the protagonist accumulates between rooms. Effect keys read by the engine: dealMult (× outgoing dmg), takeMult (× incoming dmg), firstHitMult (first attack of each battle), lowHpDealMult (when attacker is at <=40% HP), benchAlive (when player's bench is alive), critChanceBonus, critMultBonus, healMult, evadeBonus, selfDmgMult, reviveOnce (one-time revive %), benchTickHeal (bench % heal per turn), startStatusEnemy (status applied to enemy active at battle start), priorityFirstTurn (bonus priority on turn 1), reduceCursedSwap (× cursed-on-swap dmg), capturedBonusXp (× xp gained), permHpFlat (added to every party creature's max hp).
_format.lookup: engine code: src/combat/damage.js (damage mults), src/combat/passives.js (heal/crit/evasion/self-damage), src/combat/battle.js (battle-start, swap, end-of-battle, revive), src/ui/screens.js (records-hall pick).

pinned_page.name: Pinned page
pinned_page.voice: A page held to the wall by something that was not a pin.
pinned_page.desc: First attack each battle deals +35% damage.

bone_needle.name: Bone needle
bone_needle.voice: Sharper than the room. Older than the room.
bone_needle.desc: All damage you deal is increased by 8%.

wax_seal.name: Wax seal
wax_seal.voice: Sealed by a hand they will not name. The seal is warm.
wax_seal.desc: All damage you take is reduced by 12%.

letter_outside.name: Letter from outside
letter_outside.voice: It is addressed to me. The handwriting is mine.
letter_outside.desc: Once per run, when your last creature falls, it stands again at 50% hp.

misnamed_file.name: Misnamed file
misnamed_file.voice: I am not the patient on the page. I keep ~~reading~~ the page anyway.

morning_dose.name: Morning dose
morning_dose.voice: Taken before I knew it was a dose.

door_without_door.name: Door without door
door_without_door.voice: It opens onto another door. The same one.
door_without_door.desc: Self-inflicted damage from your own moves is halved.

dark_thread.name: Dark thread
dark_thread.voice: It pulls from a place I cannot reach. I let it.
dark_thread.desc: When your active is at 40% hp or below, your damage is increased by 25%.

shared_breath.name: Shared breath
shared_breath.voice: What I breathe in, the bench breathes out.
shared_breath.desc: While your bench is conscious, you deal 12% more damage.

salve_jar.name: Salve jar
salve_jar.voice: Smells faintly of [[8]]. The smell is unfamiliar.
salve_jar.desc: Healing you receive is increased by 30%.

long_gauze.name: Long gauze
long_gauze.voice: Far longer than the wound it was meant for.
long_gauze.desc: Your party gains +12 max hp permanently.

ash_in_pocket.name: Ash in pocket
ash_in_pocket.voice: Not from a fire I lit.
ash_in_pocket.desc: Bench creatures recover an extra 6% hp at the end of each turn.

mute_bell.name: Mute bell
mute_bell.desc: Your evasion is increased by 8% on every attack.

borrowed_name.name: Borrowed name
borrowed_name.voice: I sign it on every door. None of them open.
borrowed_name.desc: Your first action of every battle has +1 priority.

older_admission.name: Older admission
older_admission.voice: Filed before the building stood here.
older_admission.desc: Captured patients arrive carrying 25% extra experience.

rust_on_pin.name: Rust on pin
rust_on_pin.voice: Whatever it pinned. It is no longer there.
rust_on_pin.desc: Broken-on-swap damage you take is reduced by half.

low_voice.name: Low voice
low_voice.voice: It speaks under the room. The room hears.
low_voice.desc: Enemy active begins each battle with Drained.

small_brick.name: Small brick
small_brick.voice: Pried from a wall I do not remember.
small_brick.desc: Enemy active begins each battle with Broken.
